description: Frontend (in-place, live frontend dir): add the trainer Requests UI (Students | Requests tabs with Approve/Reject wired to FEAT-001 endpoints), slim the Students card to name + avatar only, change the student connect flow from link-immediately to SEND REQUEST (Profile + Register) with read-only trainerStatus surfacing, and rename user-visible 'Referral Code'/'referral' strings to 'Trainer Code'. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (its /api/trainer/requests + approve/reject endpoints and the request-not-link connect semantics must exist). Keep Dart identifiers, widget keys, and backend field names unchanged.
steps: Models + repo + providers for Requests: in lib/features/trainer/data/trainer_models.dart add a TrainerRequest model (studentUid, name, photoUrl, requestedAt) parsing the real {requests:[...]} payload — no mock data. In lib/features/trainer/data/trainer_repository.dart add getRequests() -> GET /api/trainer/requests (List<TrainerRequest>), approveRequest(studentUid) -> POST /api/trainer/requests/:uid/approve, rejectRequest(studentUid) -> POST /api/trainer/requests/:uid/reject, each returning a Result and never throwing into UI (match the existing method style). In lib/features/trainer/providers/trainer_providers.dart add trainerRequestsProvider (FutureProvider) wired to getRequests().

Convert lib/features/trainer/presentation/trainer_students_screen.dart into a tabbed Students | Requests view (DefaultTabController/TabBar). Students tab = the existing searchable list. Requests tab = trainerRequestsProvider list; each row shows student name + [Approve] [Reject]; approve/reject call the repo methods then ref.invalidate(trainerRequestsProvider) AND ref.invalidate(trainerStudentsProvider) so an approved student moves into Students. Fix the now-wrong empty-state copy ('Students who sign up with your referral code appear here.') to approval-aware wording.

Slim the Students-tab card: in lib/features/trainer/presentation/widgets/trainer_widgets.dart change StudentSummaryCard to render only avatar + name (drop goal/weight/activity from the initial card). Tapping still opens StudentDetailScreen (real data, unchanged). Keep the backend listStudents payload as-is.

Change the student connect flow to SEND REQUEST: in lib/features/profile/presentation/profile_screen.dart the Add Trainer/connect sheet now sends a request; on success show 'Request sent — waiting for trainer approval.'. On the My Trainer card surface trainerStatus read-only: pending -> 'Pending approval'; approved -> connected Trainer Code read-only; no link -> 'Add Trainer'. Parse trainerStatus/associationStatus from the MyTrainer model (extend trainer_models.dart if not already parsed). In lib/features/auth/presentation/register_screen.dart register-time code entry creates a pending request (same soft-fail: invalid/absent code never blocks registration); post-submit messaging reflects 'request sent'.

Rename user-visible 'Referral Code'/'referral' strings to 'Trainer Code' (strings only; keep identifiers referralCode/trainerReferralCodeProvider/ReferralCodeInfo and widget keys connectReferralField/customReferralField unless a key rename is paired with its test). lib/features/trainer/presentation/trainer_profile_screen.dart: 'YOUR REFERRAL CODE'->'MY TRAINER CODE', 'Referral code copied'->'Trainer code copied', sheet title 'Change referral code' + labels -> Trainer Code wording; present card as 'My Trainer Code / <code> / [Copy]' and '[Generate Trainer Code]' when none. lib/features/profile/presentation/profile_screen.dart: 'Invalid trainer referral code'->'Invalid Trainer Code', 'Referral Code: <code>'->'Trainer Code: <code>', connect-sheet copy/labels. lib/features/auth/presentation/register_screen.dart: 'Trainer referral code'/'Enter trainer referral code (optional)' -> Trainer Code. lib/features/auth/presentation/verify_email_screen.dart: invalid-code strings -> Trainer Code. Confirm the student connected code renders read-only plain text (it already does).

Update frontend tests in LOCKSTEP: test/connect_trainer_test.dart -> 'send request' semantics + 'Trainer Code' labels (not immediate connect). test/register_referral_test.dart -> register-time code entry = request semantics. test/trainer_referral_manage_test.dart -> 'Trainer Code' strings (keep customReferralField key unless renamed in lockstep). test/trainer_dashboard_test.dart -> update only the slim-card assertions if it asserted dropped fields. NEW test/trainer_requests_test.dart -> Requests tab lists pending requests and Approve/Reject call the endpoints + invalidate providers. Keep account_type_selector_test.dart, student_detail_test.dart, trainer_routing_test.dart (unless FEAT-003 touches it) and all unrelated suites GREEN.
acceptance_criteria: The trainer Students screen has Students and Requests tabs; the Requests tab lists real pending requests (name + Approve/Reject) and approve/reject hit the backend then refresh both lists; an approved student appears under Students.
The Students-tab card shows only avatar + name initially; tapping still opens the real-data StudentDetailScreen.

The student Add Trainer / register code flow sends a request (not an immediate link) and shows a 'request sent / waiting for approval' message; the My Trainer card shows trainerStatus (pending/approved) read-only and the connected Trainer Code read-only when approved.
No user-visible 'Referral Code'/'referral' string remains in the touched screens; Dart identifiers, widget keys, and backend field names are unchanged.
flutter analyze is clean and flutter test is green with the lockstep-updated and new tests.
verification: flutter test   (all suites pass, incl. new test/trainer_requests_test.dart and updated connect/register/referral/routing tests)
findings:
DONE. flutter analyze clean; flutter test green (125 tests, incl. new test/trainer_requests_test.dart). Committed on feat/trainer-role-session-fix as 9d17f84 (18 files, scoped stage only — untracked baseline untouched; no push).

WHAT CHANGED (frontend, in-place live dir):
- Models (lib/features/trainer/data/trainer_models.dart): added TrainerRequest {studentUid, name?, photoUrl?, requestedAt?} parsing the real {requests:[...]} payload.
- LinkTrainerResult (lib/features/auth/data/auth_repository.dart) RESHAPED for request semantics: now {ok, status, reason, trainerId, trainerName, currentTrainer?, requestedTrainer?} + getters requested (ok && status=='pending') and alreadyApproved (ok && status=='active'). REMOVED the old 'linked'/'switched'/'alreadyLinked' fields and the confirmSwitch param on linkTrainer()/connectTrainer() (backend ignores confirmSwitch now; a switch is just a new request). ANY FEAT-003 code reading result.linked must migrate to .requested/.alreadyApproved.
- Repo (trainer_repository.dart): added getRequests()->GET /api/trainer/requests, approveRequest(uid)->POST /requests/:uid/approve, rejectRequest(uid)->POST /requests/:uid/reject (all Result, never throw). connectTrainer() now single-arg.
- Providers: added trainerRequestsProvider (FutureProvider<List<TrainerRequest>>).
- UI: trainer_students_screen.dart is now DefaultTabController with Students | Requests tabs (title 'My Students'). Requests rows = avatar+name + [Reject][Approve]; on success invalidates BOTH trainerRequestsProvider and trainerStudentsProvider. StudentSummaryCard slimmed to avatar+name only (tap still opens StudentDetailScreen, real data). Dashboard still reuses the slim card.
- Student connect flow (profile_screen.dart): 'Add Trainer' sheet -> 'Send Request'; success SnackBar 'Request sent — waiting for trainer approval.'; My Trainer card shows status read-only (pending->'Pending approval' amber, approved->'Connected' + 'Trainer Code: <code>' plain-text read-only). register_screen.dart + verify_email_screen.dart reflect request-sent messaging.
- Renames (user-visible strings only; identifiers/keys/backend fields unchanged): 'YOUR REFERRAL CODE'->'MY TRAINER CODE', copy/snackbars/sheet title/labels -> Trainer Code; register field label 'Trainer Code'; invalid-code copy -> 'Invalid Trainer Code'. KEPT identifiers referralCode/trainerReferralCodeProvider/ReferralCodeInfo/_ReferralCard/_ReferralManageSheet and widget keys connectReferralField/customReferralField.

TESTS updated in lockstep: connect_trainer_test, register_referral_test (request semantics), account_type_selector_test + trainer_referral_manage_test ('Trainer Code' label), trainer_dashboard_test (slim-card comment). NEW trainer_requests_test. trainer_routing_test/student_detail_test untouched & green.

NOTES FOR FEAT-003 / finalize: (1) The connected Trainer Code read-only rendering + pending/approved status surfacing is DONE in profile_screen.dart — don't duplicate. (2) MyTrainer model already parses status/associationStatus; backend mirrors trainerStatus on approve (per FEAT-001). The My Trainer card reads associationStatus??status. (3) backend confirmSwitch is accepted-but-ignored; frontend no longer sends it.
